text: Not a signal from a distant star.
Not a blurry light in the night sky.
It is three in the afternoon.
Then the sunlight turns strangely dim.
Something is sliding in front of the Sun.
It is almost three kilometres wide.
The nearest star is more than four light-years away.
Our fastest spacecraft would need over six thousand years to get there.
Whoever built this did not just cross that distance.
And now… it is not moving.
Our radio and TV signals have been leaking into space for about a hundred years.
This may not be an accident.
